note: Work queue for the autopilot driver. See .claude/automation/README.md. This file is NOT a mirror of docs/status.md — status.md remains the single source of truth for every roadmap item and every ruling. This file lists only work the Project Owner has explicitly opted into automation, which is why entries are added by hand rather than generated. Nothing is eligible by default.

forbidden_actions: changing branch protection or any repository setting

changing any item's `eligible` flag, or anything in the `policy` block, in queue.json — the driver may update an item's `state`, `consecutive_failures`, `halted` and `halt_reason`, and append to run-log.jsonl, and nothing else in .claude/automation
approving anything on the Project Owner's behalf
editing an approved PRD, design, plan or ADR to make a task pass
adding a production dependency without an Owner approval entry in this file
rerunning CI more than twice for the same commit

items.title: Vendor Instrument Sans instead of fetching it at build time
items.note: Done by hand on 2026-08-27 (85a496f) as the worked example this queue is modelled on, and because it is the prerequisite that stops the driver mistaking a CDN timeout for a code defect.

items.title: Upgrade league/commonmark to 2.9.0 to clear six denial-of-service advisories
items.acceptance: composer audit reports no advisories against league/commonmark; full suite green; no other package's constraint changed.
items.note: Arrives through laravel/framework, which already allows ^2.8.1, so no framework change is needed. This is a transitive upgrade within an existing constraint, not a new dependency, so it does not need the Owner's new-dependency gate. If the upgrade turns out to require a framework bump, that IS a stack change: stop and escalate. Resolved to 2.10.0 rather than the 2.9.0 named here — Composer picked the newest release satisfying laravel/framework's existing ^2.8.1, and the acceptance criterion is the advisories clearing, not a specific version.
